summary: Add verified controller lease settlement and safe ignored-runtime worktree pruning

delivery.outcome: Allow local-single-clone controller terminal lease settlement from verified terminal receipts without original writer session context, safely prune merged canonical worktrees containing only allowlisted disposable runtime caches after terminal lease verification, and release standard 0.20.152.
nonGoals: No takeover of active unmerged, dirty, or publication-frozen leases
No forced git worktree removal or deletion of unknown ignored files such as .env or snapshots
No target repository edits inside this Governance Hub

architecture.decision: Extend scripts/terminal_lease_release.py with settle_verified_leases (--settle-verified [--ticket] [--apply]) gated on verified terminal receipts, ancestry, clean/absent checkout, and O_NOFOLLOW lease_lock CAS with immutable controller settlement receipts; extend scripts/prune_merged_worktrees.py to remove only O_NOFOLLOW-anchored allowlisted runtime caches on terminal-leased canonical checkouts with no live process handles before non-forced git worktree remove; advance 0.20.152 version projections.
interfaceChanges: scripts/prune_merged_worktrees.py --include-ignored-runtime / --no-include-ignored-runtime safe runtime-cache cleanup for terminal-leased canonical worktrees
architecture.rollback: Revert through protected review; existing owner-handoff requests and lease schemas remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Controller terminal settlement plans read-only by default, releases verified terminal leases with immutable settlement receipts, and refuses unmerged, dirty, frozen, ambiguous, or CAS-raced leases.

Merged canonical worktrees with terminal leases and allowlisted runtime caches prune cleanly without --force while unknown ignored files, non-terminal leases, and open process checkouts are preserved.
Bundled parity, version 0.20.152 parity, wheel build, and Governance Hub gate pass.
